popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book II stages Mercury's bribe, Minerva's Envy, and Aglauros turned to stone — the jealous sister who bars the god from her sibling Herse.

popCulture.title: Aglaurus, daughter of Cecrops
popCulture.description: Cecrops' middle daughter remains Ovid's emblem of envy punished — the Athenian princess who opens Pandora's box of spite and ends as rock.

popCulture.title: Herse
popCulture.description: The fairest Cecropid Mercury sought — Herse's beauty and Aglauros' gatekeeping keep the Athenian sisters paired in reception.
